draft_ko: 이 카드는 다른 동향이 플레이되거나, 러너가 아젠다를 훔치기 전에는 폐기되지 않는다. 러너가 성공적인 런을 수행할 때마다 1[credit]을 얻는다.

tm_hits.en_text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. Gain 1[credit] whenever the Runner makes a successful run.
This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The Runner must spend credits first for each trace attempt during a run.
This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The first piece of ice encountered each turn has -2 strength for the remainder of the run.

draft_ko: [click]: 연구개발부(R&D)로 런을 수행한다. 성공하면 카드를 액세스하는 대신, 연구개발부(R&D)의 맨 위로부터 3장의 카드를 본다. 그 중 1장의 카드를 비용을 지불하지 않고 폐기한다.(그 카드가 일반적으로는 폐기될 수 없다 해도 폐기할 수 있다.) 기업은 연구개발부(R&D)를 섞는다.

tm_hits.en_text: [click]: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, look at the top 3 cards of R&D. Trash 1 of those cards, then the Corp shuffles R&D.
Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, you may look at the top 5 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order.
[click]: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, you may choose 1 unrezzed non-ice card with no advancement counters on it. The Corp shuffles that card into R&D.
[subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
When the Runner encounters this ice, they must take 1 tag or end the run. Hosted power counter: Give the Runner 1 tag. [subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, place 1 power counter on this ice.

When you rez this ice, take 1 bad publicity.
[subroutine] Trace[1]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
[subroutine] End the run if the Runner is tagged.
